subject.title: [Feature]: Add portable Agent Bundles for export/import across OpenClaw instances

question: Should portable agent bundles become a first-class core CLI/Gateway feature now, or should this be routed through ClawHub/plugin bundle distribution with only narrow core API gaps tracked separately?
rationale: The request is useful and current main does not implement it, but implementation would set a new portability, config, and security contract that automation should not choose without maintainer intent.

options.title: Design a core bundle contract first
options.body: Keep this issue open for a maintainer-sponsored design of the manifest, dry-run, secret exclusion, overwrite, skill, env, and migration boundaries before any implementation PR.

options.title: Route to ClawHub/plugin bundles
options.body: If maintainers decide existing CLI/plugin surfaces are sufficient, close or narrow this to external bundle publishing plus documentation and only track missing generic APIs separately.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Leave portability as documented manual migration for now and revisit when agent deployment becomes a higher-priority roadmap item.

recommendation.title: Design a core bundle contract first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for a maintainer-sponsored design of the manifest, dry-run, secret exclusion, overwrite, skill, env, and migration boundaries before any implementation PR.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the clearest current owner signal for the agent CLI/Gateway surface and the VISION.md product-boundary guidance this decision depends on.
